The big gauge shows one of three things. Pick it in Settings, or with the Big gauge tile in your Quick Settings panel. On many phones a tap on the gauge on your home screen switches it too (Samsung's home screen doesn't pass taps to wallpapers).

• Power: watts going into the battery (to the right) or out of it (to the left, with a minus).
• CPU clock: how fast the processor runs, as a share of its top speed. Only on phones that allow reading it.
• GPS speed: your speed in km/h or mph. A red mark shows the top speed of the current drive.
